ops.text: In addition, SFJ hereby grants to PB a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license, with the right to sublicense through multiple tiers, to use and modify the Trial Data Package, including all Research Results, for PB's business.

input.comment: [Playbook] SFJ owns the Trial Data Package (all trial data generated by or for PB) until PB pays to buy it back, leaving PB with no right to use its own data in the meantime. We have added our fallback position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense that data for PB's business, leaving SFJ's ownership and the purchase mechanic untouched.
input.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence back to PB over the Trial Data Package and Research Results.
